fullPassage: We tend to break up time into units, such as weeks, months, and seasons; in a series of studies among farmers in India and students in North America, psychologists found that if a deadline is on the other side of a "break" — such as in the New Year — we're more likely to see it as remote, and, as a result, be less ready to jump into action. What you need to do in that situation is find another way to think about the timeframe. For example, if it's November and the deadline is in January, it's better to tell yourself you have to get it done "this winter" rather than "next year." The best approach is to view deadlines as a challenge that you have to meet within a period that's imminent. That way the stress is more manageable, and you have a better chance of starting — and therefore finishing — in good time.

❌ ④ (A) '행운'은 break up time 문맥에 부적절
det.tip: break: ① break up = 나누다 ② get a break = 행운을 얻다 ③ 부수다, 깨뜨리다

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"about to happen; impending"

det.korean: 곧 일어날; 임박한
det.analysis:
❌ ① permanent(영구적인) — 곧 일어남이 아닌 영원함
❌ ② dominant(지배적인) — 의미 다름
❌ ③ prominent(저명한) — 의미 다름
✅ ④ imminent(임박한) — 영영 정의와 일치 ←정답
det.tip: imminent = about to happen = 임박한

questions.passage: That way the stress is more manageable, and you have a better chance of starting — and therefore __________ (finish) — in good time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 스트레스가 더 감당할 수 있게 되고, 시작할 — 그리고 따라서 끝낼(finishing) — 더 나은 기회를 갖게 된다.
det.analysis: finish(동사원형) → finishing(동명사). 'a chance of starting and finishing'에서 전치사 of 뒤 동명사 병렬 구조.
det.tip: of + V-ing 병렬: a chance of starting and finishing → 둘 다 동명사

questions.passage: In a series of __________ (study) among farmers in India and students in North America, psychologists found that if a deadline is on the other side of a "break," we're more likely to see it as remote.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 인도의 농부들과 북미의 학생들을 대상으로 한 일련의 연구들(studies)에서, 심리학자들은 발견했다.
det.analysis: study(단수) → studies(복수). 'a series of + 복수명사' 구문이므로 복수형 studies가 필요.
det.tip: a series of + 복수명사: a series of studies(일련의 연구들)

questions.passage: We tend to break up time into units, such as weeks, months, and seasons; in a series of studies among farmers in India and students in North America, psychologists found that if a deadline is on the other side of a "break" — such as in the New Year — we're more likely to see it as remote, and, as a result, be less ready to __________. What you need to do in that situation is find another way to think about the timeframe. For example, if it's November and the deadline is in January, it's better to tell yourself you have to get it done "this winter" rather than "next year." The best approach is to view deadlines as a challenge that you have to meet within a period that's imminent. That way the stress is more manageable, and you have a better chance of starting — and therefore finishing — in good time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 마감이 멀게 느껴지면 '행동에 나서는(jump into action)' 준비가 덜 된다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① take a break(쉬다) — be less ready to take a break는 문맥 부적절
❌ ② slow down(속도를 줄이다) — 이미 행동하지 않는 상태에서 줄일 수 없음
✅ ③ jump into action(행동에 나서다) — 마감이 멀면 행동할 준비가 덜 됨 ←정답
❌ ④ give up(포기하다) — be less ready to give up은 문맥 반대
det.tip: jump into action = 행동에 나서다, 즉시 행동을 취하다

questions.passage: We tend to break up time into units, such as weeks, months, and seasons; in a series of studies among farmers in India and students in North America, psychologists found that if a deadline is on the other side of a "break" — such as in the New Year — we're more likely to see it as remote, and, as a result, be less ready to jump into action. What you need to do in that situation is find another way to think about the timeframe. For example, if it's November and the deadline is in January, it's better to tell yourself you have to get it done "this winter" rather than "next year." The best approach is to view deadlines as a challenge that you have to meet within a period that's imminent. That way the stress is more manageable, and you have a better chance of starting — and therefore finishing — __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시작할 — 그리고 끝낼 — 더 나은 기회를 '충분한 시간을 두고(in good time)' 갖게 된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① in good time(충분한 시간을 두고) — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② at any cost(무슨 수를 써서라도) — 비용/대가 맥락으로 문맥 부적절
❌ ③ by all means(어떻게든, 물론) — 허락/수단 맥락으로 문맥 부적절
❌ ④ in no time(즉시) — 유사하지만 원문은 '여유 있게'의 의미
det.tip: in good time = 충분한 시간을 두고, 여유 있게. ≠ in no time(즉시)
